description: This file is a script that manages the post-build process for a project. It handles copying static assets, creating runtime alias files, and executing other build stage functions related to runtime setup.

methods.name: listStaticExtensionAssetOutputs
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of destination paths for static extension assets.

methods.name: copyStaticExtensionAssets
methods.description: Copies specified static extension assets from source to destination directories, creating directories as needed.

methods.name: writeStableRootRuntimeAliases
methods.description: Creates alias files in the distribution directory for runtime assets matching specific filename patterns.

methods.name: runRuntimePostBuild
methods.description: Executes the sequence of functions needed to prepare the runtime environment after build.
